rings.title: Adopt
rings.description: Mature and proven in production. This is our default choice and should be used on all new projects.

rings.title: Trial
rings.description: Worth using on selected projects, under the supervision of a lead developer, to confirm it fits our needs before adopting it.

rings.title: Assess
rings.description: Recently released or new to us and worth exploring through research or a proof of concept. Not yet for client projects.

rings.title: Hold
rings.description: Do not start new projects with it. Existing usages should be phased out when the opportunity arises.
